route_summary: Four attempts. 001 (effectively blind) rediscovered Milton 1981's attainability rule exactly and censused bounded-rank laminates. 002 derived what attainment demands of the fields and killed two obstruction conjectures. 003 PROVED attainability is upward closed in f1 (coating with the comparison medium preserves HS-optimality), collapsing the problem to the bottom of each f2:f3 ray, and established that the literature claims attainment throughout. 004 BUILDS the object: an explicit closed-form rank-5 laminate attaining HS_lo exactly in Q at f1 = m11 = 2*Theta*sqrt(m2)(1-sqrt(m2)), strictly below Milton's threshold at every m2; with 003's lemma this covers all f1 >= m11. Status LIVE pending an independent third implementation. Frontier question is now whether m11 is the true threshold (004 lead 1). Read 004 for the construction, 003 for the lemma, 002 for the diagnostics.

attempts.one_line: Exact two-phase HS attainment and the Milton (1981) three-phase attainability rule rediscovered and certified in Q; in the region where the assemblage fails and Cherkaev's bound is plain HS, an exhaustive rank-3/rank-4 laminate screen gets within 5.5e-4 of HS_lo, with every winner certified exactly and verified by the second implementation.
attempts.range: Two-phase: 3 conductivity pairs x 5 fractions, exact. Milton rule: grids k/8 at sigma=(1,2,5), k/40 at (1,3,20), k/30 at (1/7,5/3,101/2), plus 19924 random exact instances for the equivalence with m1 >= 2 Theta (1-m2). Screen: rank 3 over four normals (11520 topologies) at the k/8 grid for sigma=(1,2,5) both sides and gap-region points for (1,3,20); rank 4 with axis normals (33600 topologies) at five gap points; seed 1, 2 restarts. 27 certified records.
gaps: Nesi 1995's bound was not transcribed (paywalled); which published bound is tightest at the census points is unresolved.
Whether Albin-Cherkaev-Nesi 2007 or Cherkaev 2009 exhibit a structure attaining HS on m11 <= m1 < 2 Theta (1-m2) was not settled.
Rank-4 screen used axis normals and two restarts only; its value is an upper estimate of the rank-4 optimum.
The Milton attribution rests on two secondary sources; the 1981 paper itself was not reached.
Screens at fixed rank are evidence about that rank and normal set, not about all microstructures.
attempts.note: Mode is informed only because the director read STATUS.md and docs/CYCLE.md; the problem had no attempts, so the attempt is effectively blind. Work was delegated to four Sonnet subagents (certifier, screener, shape analyst, literature skeptic) briefed on tier-0 material and this attempt's own scripts; the director verified the Milton-equivalence algebra and the exactness checks itself.

attempts.one_line: Attaining the HS lower bound forces uniform target fields in every phase of nonvanishing polarization and a precisely determined NONZERO field variance in the comparison-medium phase, Var1=(c^2 S2-1)/f1; the gap then decomposes exactly into mean and variance defects, which kills two natural obstruction conjectures and shows rank 5 is parameter-starved rather than floored.
attempts.range: Exact in Q: the assemblage realises the attainment fields at every feasible point tried; the equivalence of E2<=E0, HS_lo<=sigma2 and Milton's threshold on the whole k/8 grid at sigma=(1,2,5); the Var_req closed form on 3 instances incl. an unrelated triple; the gap decomposition on all 12 certified lower-side records at sigma=(1,2,5) plus the assemblage; the Keller-Dykhne reduction on all 27 certified records; the path-product rule on 3 axis-normal trees at 3 applied directions each.
gaps: Necessity of the attainment-field condition (*) is assumed, not proved here: it is the classical HS equality analysis but was not re-derived or cited to a page. Everything that would RULE OUT a structure leans on it.
The rank 7-8 parameter count is heuristic; the conditions are not shown independent.
Whether Var1 = Var_req is automatic given (*), correct fractions and isotropy is open, and would change the count.
No claim either way on attainability of HS in the gap region.
attempts.note: Uses no new search: the two refutations come out of 001's own certified data once the field diagnostics exist.

attempts.one_line: Coating an HS-optimal structure with extra comparison-medium phase preserves HS-optimality exactly (proved, 12 instances), so attainability is upward closed in f1 along fixed f2:f3 and the construction problem collapses to the bottom of each ray; 001's rank-3 feasibility floor is explained as a phase-1 leaf-volume degeneration against a diverging required variance; and the literature (Cherkaev 2009 Thm 8.1) claims HS IS attained on the whole open interval.
attempts.range: Lemma proved in general and verified exactly in Q on 12 instances (3 base structures x 4 coating fractions), isotropy exact and rho=1/2 every time. Variance-collapse mechanism computed exactly along the f2:f3=1:6 ray at sigma=(1,2,5) for 001's rank-3 family down to its floor, and the rank-4 family down to f1=1/96. Rank-5 gap 1.6e-5 is the best found in a still-running axis-normal sweep, hence an upper bound on the rank-5 optimum.
gaps: No HS-attaining structure below Milton's threshold has been built or verified here; the rank-5 number is a small gap, not an attainment.
Tension unresolved: a near-constant per-rank gap ratio looks like geometric convergence, which sits oddly beside the literature's finite-rank attainment claim.
Cherkaev's Remark 8.2 credits Gibiansky-Sigmund 2000, an elasticity paper; the conductivity reading is a reinterpretation, flagged not smoothed.
The T^2-structure's isotropic member could not be reconstructed from the transcribed formulas, so no ready-to-verify exact tree is in hand.
Nothing established about attainability BELOW m11.
attempts.note: The coating lemma was proved and verified here independently, then found to be exactly the outer part of Cherkaev's published L13,2,13,1,1 construction; the agreement is convergent, not derived.

attempts.one_line: An explicit closed-form rank-5 laminate that attains the 2D three-phase Hashin-Shtrikman LOWER bound exactly in Q at f1 = m11 = 2*Theta*sqrt(m2)(1-sqrt(m2)), strictly below Milton's threshold 2*Theta*(1-m2) at every m2, with a3 a genuinely free parameter; with 003's coating lemma it gives attainment for all f1 >= m11.
attempts.range: Exact attainment on 1055 random (sigma, r, a3) instances with zero failures (1099 skipped outside the stated domain a3 > 1-r, f3 > 0); both harness routes agree and Keller-Dykhne holds on every tree; the written record passes verify_laminate.py; 002's field diagnostics come out exactly (phases 2,3 uniform on target, var_term == var_required == 2/9 at sigma=(1,2,5), r=1/2).
gaps: NOT YET VERIFIED to the repo's bar: both agreeing routes live in the harness this attempt used; a third independent implementation is commissioned but not yet returned.
The identities a1 = r*Theta and a5 = (s2 s3 - s1^2)/((s2+s1)(s3-s1)) were found by pattern-matching exact numerics and checked widely, not derived.
Nothing established about f1 < m11: whether m11 is the true attainability threshold is open and is now the frontier question.
Novelty not settled: this reproduces what Cherkaev 2009 Thm 8.1 asserts and should be recorded as an independent constructive rediscovery unless the skeptic's literature check says otherwise.
Minimal rank for attainment at m11 is not established; rank 4 was not searched at exactly f1 = m11.
attempts.note: Seeded by a delegated rank-5 sweep, then solved exactly rather than by rounding floats (rounding provably fails, since it moves the volume fractions and hence the target). The attaining set is a one-parameter family, which is why float optimizers wander instead of converging.
